about: What the base desktop (platform plus Orpheus or Kairos) may cost at rest, checked by bin/ryoku-dev-perf-baseline --budget. The numbers are measurements, not limits: each limit is the number plus the margins. docs/performance.md, 'The budget gate', explains every entry and how to update it.

reference.machine: Hyperion lab: systemd-nspawn, nested niri at 1920x1080 on headless Weston, AMD iGPU, still 4K wallpaper (rices/default/wall.webp)
reference.scenario: idle: empty workspace, no music, nothing open, 120 s settle, 60 s window
reference.measured: 2026-11-07: five runs of this script's gate on a fresh desktop each (three Orpheus, two Kairos), Hyperion ad9146fd4 with the tree's ryoku-wm-niri and niri config; each number is the highest of those runs

shell-daemon.source: PSS and CPU from the lab (20.7 to 22.9 MB); wakeups from the bare-metal at-rest run in docs/performance.md

lab.why: in the container the daemon's input watch falls back to a 2 s poll (34 to 44 wakeups/s measured)

wm-provider.source: the daemon's and Ryogami's ryoku-wm-niri watch, 9.7 to 9.8 MB together; the daemon's warm act child leaves after 30 s without an action, so it is not here at rest

wallpaper.source: ryogami daemon with a still wallpaper, 15.4 to 15.7 MB

session-daemons.source: ryoku-bt-agent (sh, sleep infinity, bluetoothctl --agent); nothing in it wakes at rest

shell-ui.source: qs -c shell: 314 to 320 MB PSS, 245 to 250 MB VRAM plus GTT, 7.9 to 8.2 wakeups/s

compositor.source: nested niri under Orpheus, 75 to 78 MB PSS

shell-ui.source: qs -c shell under Kairos: 309 to 310 MB PSS, 247 to 251 MB, 8.0 wakeups/s

compositor.source: nested niri under Kairos, 77 to 79 MB PSS
